mapper.insert: INSERT INTO attendance ( attendance_no, class_session_no, student_no, attendance_state ) SELECT attendance_seq.nextval, #{sessionNo}, sc.student_no, '미출결' FROM student_course sc WHERE sc.course_no = #{courseNo} AND sc.student_course_status IN ('신청', '수강중')
mapper.update: update attendance set attendance_state = #{attendanceState}, attendance_at = SYSTIMESTAMP where attendance_no = #{attendanceNo}
mapper.select: select c.employee_no from attendance a join class_session cs on a.class_session_no = cs.session_no join schedule sc on cs.schedule_no = sc.schedule_no join course c on sc.course_no = c.course_no where a.attendance_no = #{attendanceNo}

SELECT a.attendance_no AS attendanceNo, a.student_no AS studentNo, acc.account_name AS studentName, acc.account_phone AS studentPhone, a.attendance_state AS attendanceState, a.attendance_at AS attendanceAt FROM attendance a JOIN student s ON a.student_no = s.student_no JOIN account acc ON s.account_no = acc.account_no WHERE a.class_session_no = #{sessionNo} ORDER BY acc.account_name ASC

select s.student_no, ac.account_name AS studentName, ac.account_phone from student s join account ac on s.account_no = ac.account_no where substr(replace(ac.account_phone, '-', ''), -4) = #{phoneTail} and ac.account_status = 'Y' order by ac.account_name asc
select s.student_no, ac.account_name, ac.account_phone from student s join account ac on s.account_no = ac.account_no where s.student_no = #{studentNo}

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT a.attendance_no AS attendanceNo, a.attendance_state AS attendanceState, cs.session_no AS sessionNo, cs.session_start AS sessionStart, cs.session_end AS sessionEnd, c.course_title AS courseTitle, ac.account_name AS studentName FROM attendance a JOIN class_session cs ON a.class_session_no = cs.session_no JOIN schedule s ON cs.schedule_no = s.schedule_no JOIN course c ON s.course_no = c.course_no JOIN student st ON a.student_no = st.student_no JOIN account ac ON st.account_no = ac.account_no WHERE a.student_no = #{studentNo} AND cs.session_status = '진행중' AND SYSTIMESTAMP BETWEEN (cs.session_start - INTERVAL '30' MINUTE) AND cs.session_end ORDER BY CASE WHEN a.attendance_state = '미출결' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END ASC, cs.session_no DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1
